name: Gulf Shores Massage Therapy
description: Gulf Shores Massage Therapy, based in Gulf Shores, AL, is a reputable provider of massage therapy and skincare services. With over 15 years of collective experience in the massage, esthetics, health, and wellness industry, our main objective is to promote relaxation and balance. By choosing our services, you are investing in your overall well-being. Our professional bodywork, massage, and facials are carefully crafted to support a healthy and contented body. At Gulf Shores Massage Therapy, we prioritize personalized sessions tailored to your specific needs. From the moment you step through our doors, our skilled therapist, Candice, will provide you with a seamless experience. Our diverse range of sessions caters to your therapeutic and wellness requirements, complemented by the use of hot towels and our own custom-made lotions and creams. While couples sessions are currently unavailable, please don't hesitate to reach out to us via call or text for any additional information you may require. Please note that clients must be at least the age of 16 to book any session.
